newsitem.title: USA: Duke Catawba unit seen at 100 pct by Weds.
newsitem.headline: Duke Catawba unit seen at 100 pct by Weds.

text.p: Duke Power Co's 1,129 megawatt Catawba nuclear power unit 1 will reach full within one or two days, returning from a scheduled maintenance and refueling outage, a company spokesman said.
"It should be back at full power in a day or two," spokesman Rick Zuercher said Monday.
The Clover, S.C., unit was taken off line June 12 for the refueling and maintenance, and began generating electricity over the weekend.
Catawba unit 2, also with 1,129 megawatts in Clover, was producing normally at full capacity as of early Monday.
